Frequently asked questions
How does pricing work for private projects?

Subscribing to a paid plan on SonarQube Cloud allows you to create a private organization containing private projects.


There are two paid plans available: Team and Enterprise.  You pay upfront for a maximum number of private lines of code to be analyzed in your organization.

SonarQube Cloud Team plan pricing starts at Euro 30 monthly for analysis of up to 100k LOC. Other LOC increments are available, up to 1.9M LOC.

We also offer a free tier that allows you to explore SonarQube using your private projects up to a maximum of 50k LoC.

    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "How does pricing work for private projects?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "Subscribing to a paid plan on SonarQube Cloud allows you to create a private organization containing private projects.\n\nThere are two paid plans available: Team and Enterprise.  You pay upfront for a maximum number of private lines of code to be analyzed in your organization.\n\nSonarQube Cloud Team plan pricing starts at Euro 30 monthly for analysis of up to 100k LOC. Other LOC increments are available, up to 1.9M LOC.\nWe also offer a free tier that allows you to explore SonarQube using your private projects up to a maximum of 50k LoC."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "What payment options are available?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "For the Team plan, payment is completed online via credit card and will happen automatically every month. For all billing questions, use the Contact Us form."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "What is a Line of Code (LOC) on SonarQube Cloud?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "LOCs are computed by summing up the lines of code of each project analyzed in SonarQube Cloud. The LOCs used for a project are the ones found during the most recent analysis of this project."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "How are Lines of Code (LOCs) counted towards billing?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "Only LOCs from your private projects are counted toward your maximum number of LOCs. \n\nIf your project contains branches, we only count the lines of code in your largest branch\n\nThe count is not related to how frequently the source code is analyzed. If your private project has 6K LOCs and you analyze it 100 times in the month, this will be counted as 6K for the billing. \n\nIf you are getting close to the threshold, you will be notified to either upgrade your plan or reduce the number of LOCs in your projects. \n\nPlease note - in the future, we plan to introduce compute analysis measurements to enable admin monitoring of the volume of analyses made. "
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "When will I be invoiced?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "With SonarQube Cloud Team plan you will be invoiced once a month, the day of the month after your trial ends. For example if you start your free trial on January 1st, it will last until January 14th and you will be first billed on January 15th for your upcoming month, e.g. January 15th to February 15th."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "Which programming languages does SonarQube Cloud support?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "SonarQube Cloud currently supports the following languages and frameworks in the Team plan: Ansible, Azure Resource Manager, C, C++, CloudFormation, C#, CSS, Docker, Flex, Go, HTML, Java, JavaScript, Kotlin, Kubernetes, Objective-C, PHP, PL/SQL, Python, RPG, Ruby, Rust, Scala, Swift, Terraform, TypeScript, T-SQL, VB.NET, VB6, XML, JSON, YAML and Groovy. Additionally, the Enterprise Plan offers ABAP, COBOL, JCL, RPG, PL/I, and Apex."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "Is support available for SonarQube Cloud?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "Yes.\nThe SonarQube Cloud Enterprise plan includes commercial support (starting at 5M LOC). \nFor the Team plan commercial support is available to purchase (contact sales).\nFor the Free plan (as well as Enterprise and Team plans) the Sonar Community is a channel for you to ask questions and receive help from our community members."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "Can I try a private project on SonarQube Cloud for free?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "Yes. The free tier enables you to explore SonarQube with your private project up to a maximum size of 50k LoC. Sign up here"
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "Can I cancel my subscription?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "Of course! There's no commitment. You can delete your paid organization whenever you wish. Or simply downgrade to the free tier if you wish to keep on analyzing some public projects."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "Can I try the new enterprise features?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "Yes. Please contact sales and request a trial of SonarQube Cloud Enterprise features to discover the value they will bring to your organization."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "How can I get SCA?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "SCA is available with the Advanced Security subscription available to Enterprise plan users. It offers vulnerability detection, license checks, and SBOM visibility. Head here to discover more."
      }
    }
  ]

The LOCs used for a project are the ones found during the most recent analysis of this project.</p></div></div></div><div class="css-wbgtw2 e1ertki80"><button aria-controls="95c441d3-6f41-4d41-a183-088ddecb5483" aria-expanded="false" class="css-79elbk e1ertki85"><h3 class="css-obzh18 e1ertki84">How are Lines of Code (LOCs) counted towards billing?</h3><span class="css-1m8d764 e1ertki83"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="icon" focusable="false" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><use href="/static/icons-sprite-223c412724db54b22b27a32ed789e4fe.svg#bx-chevron-right"></use></svg></span></button><div aria-hidden="true" id="95c441d3-6f41-4d41-a183-088ddecb5483" class="css-1t5jwg8 e1ertki82"><div class="css-18uq4do e1ertki81"><p>Only LOCs from your private projects are counted toward your maximum number of LOCs. <br>
<br>
If your project contains branches, we only count the lines of code in your largest branch<br>
<br>
The count is not related to how frequently the source code is analyzed. If your private project has 6K LOCs and you analyze it 100 times in the month, this will be counted as 6K for the billing. <br>
<br>
If you are getting close to the threshold, you will be notified to either upgrade your plan or reduce the number of LOCs in your projects. <br>
<br>
Please note - in the future, we plan to introduce compute analysis measurements to enable admin monitoring of the volume of analyses made. </p></div></div></div><div class="css-wbgtw2 e1ertki80"><button aria-controls="b6e76186-ecee-4ffe-b8ff-45976150334c" aria-expanded="false" class="css-79elbk e1ertki85"><h3 class="css-obzh18 e1ertki84">When will I be invoiced?</h3><span class="css-1m8d764 e1ertki83"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="icon" focusable="false" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><use href="/static/icons-sprite-223c412724db54b22b27a32ed789e4fe.svg#bx-chevron-right"></use></svg></span></button><div aria-hidden="true" id="b6e76186-ecee-4ffe-b8ff-45976150334c" class="css-1t5jwg8 e1ertki82"><div class="css-18uq4do e1ertki81"><p>With SonarQube Cloud Team plan you will be invoiced once a month, the day of the month after your trial ends.
